L408: ### cite46†Usage beyond limits L409: 
L410: If you also have credits on your Zen balance, you can enable the Use balance option in the console. When enabled, Go will fall back to your Zen balance after you’ve reached your usage limits instead of blocking requests.

L413: ### cite47†Why some models have lower usage L414: 
L415: With Go, the included monthly usage varies by model.
L416: 
L417: For most models, we make this work through bulk discounts and reserved GPU capacity. We then pass those savings on to you as higher monthly usage.
L418: 
L419: For some models, we haven’t had the opportunity to negotiate a discount or host them at a lower cost, either because the model is new or because their public pricing is already discounted.
L420: For these models, you still get a little more than if you paid the model providers directly; this is why their included monthly usage is lower.
